objects.name: runs_conversation_turn
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runs_conversation_turn
               ON runs(agent_id, conversation_id, turn_index)

objects.name: learning_candidates
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE learning_candidates (
                agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                id TEXT NOT NULL,
                data TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(agent_id, id)
            )

objects.name: messages
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
                run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                position INTEGER NOT NULL,
                data TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(run_id, position)
            )

objects.name: metadata
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE metadata (
                key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                data TEXT NOT NULL
            )

objects.name: runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE runs (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                turn_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
                input TEXT NOT NULL,
                result TEXT
            )

objects.name: semantic_annotations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE semantic_annotations (
                agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                id TEXT NOT NULL,
                data TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(agent_id, id)
            )

objects.name: snapshots
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE snapshots (
                agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                sync_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                data TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(agent_id, source_id)
            )

objects.name: sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sources (
                agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                id TEXT NOT NULL,
                data TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(agent_id, id)
            )

objects.name: syncs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE syncs (
                agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                id TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                data TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(agent_id, id)
            )
